introduction: The world is filling with low effort AI content… but we’d rather quit than make AI slop. That’s why

vocabulary.definition: the quality of being clever, original, and inventive
vocabulary.example: Her ingenuity in solving complex problems impressed her colleagues.

vocabulary.definition: to present or show something in a different way
vocabulary.example: The artist reframes traditional landscapes in a modern, abstract style.
The vibrant colors of the painting brought life to the room.

vocabulary.definition: filled to capacity; very full or crowded
vocabulary.example: The conference was jam-packed with attendees from around the world.

vocabulary.definition: lacking human qualities or the ability to show empathy
vocabulary.example: The factory was described as a soulless place where workers were treated like machines.

vocabulary.definition: produced in a mechanical or unthinking manner
vocabulary.example: The artist refused to churn out generic paintings and focused on creating unique pieces.
